caseName: City Center Motel, Inc. v. Florida Hotel & Restaurant Commission
caseNameFull: CITY CENTER MOTEL, INC. v. FLORIDA HOTEL AND RESTAURANT COMMISSION
attorneys: John H. Cotten for appellant., Weldon G. Starry for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
